One-tap interaction logger (SRS FR-CON-002/003): create the interaction node, a WITH edge to the person, any follow-up reminders, and immediately recompute that person's strength. FR-002: the node, edge, revisions, and reminders commit in ONE transaction. Previously each was a separate write, so a mid-sequence failure could leave an interaction with no edge (invisible to the person page, but counted by CRM) or reminders with no interaction.
Undo a just-logged interaction: soft-delete it and re-derive strength.

Mark a résumé as sent → create/link an application node (SRS FR-RES-018). FR-011: `final` is an invariant, not a label. Only a résumé that passed the one-page and ≥95%-coverage gate at finalize time can be sent, otherwise a draft that failed those checks could become a real application. `sent` is also terminal: re-sending would spawn duplicate application nodes.

Recompile a saved output and (re)upload PDF/TeX to Cloudinary (FR-RES-019 recovery). Older outputs finalized before storage was wired, or during a storage outage, keep their selection/config, this fills in private artifacts without a full Tailor pass. When the stored selection is empty (legacy seed rows), re-run tailor first.
Build the résumé model, render LaTeX, and compile (SRS FR-RES-011/012/013).
Finalize: one-page fit loop (FR-RES-014) + ≥95% coverage gate (FR-RES-015).
Assemble the résumé model for the visual editor, no LaTeX, no compile.
Score atoms + select to the page budget, auto (knapsack) or manual (SRS FR-RES-007/008/009).
What the next purge would remove (FR-006), powers the Trash retention notice.
Purge on demand. Idempotent; the scheduler calls the same code path.
Unified FTS + filter grammar (SRS FR-SRCH-001/002/003).
⌘P fuzzy quick-switcher (SRS FR-SRCH-004).
Disconnect GitHub: drop the credential, keep the imported records.

Write-only PAT endpoint. The token goes to the secret store, never into application data (FR-004). When the deployment injects GITHUB_PAT from a secret manager the store is read-only and rotation belongs there, so this returns 409 rather than keeping a second, divergent copy.

/status health page (SRS FR-SET-006): DB, storage, build-svc, counts. FR-005: counts come from aggregate queries, not from loading both tables. The Shell polls this every 60s, so the original implementation read the entire database once a minute per open client, at the stated ceiling, ~300k documents/minute.

Existing values for a form field (FR-CAP-003). Two sources: ?kind=city a curated pool that crosses types ?type=organization&prop=industry this field's own previous values The second needs no curation, so every text field in the app gets suggestions without anything being wired per field. `type` may name a node or an edge type, the vocabularies are disjoint (`organization` vs `KNOWS`), so one parameter is unambiguous. An unrecognised kind, or a field nothing has been typed into yet, returns an empty list rather than an error: that is the ordinary first case, and the input has to stay usable regardless. Scanning and caching live in services/suggest.ts, this route only parses.
